reading.title: Letter regarding Penn Place I project PILOT Agreement

candidates.quote: The Penn Place I project involves the new construction of a one hundred sixty eight (168) unit affordable rental housing community for families earning sixty percent (60%) or below of the Area Median Income (“AMI”), located at 5501 Penn Crossing Drive, District Heights, Maryland 20747.

The Penn Place I project involves the new construction of a one hundred sixty eight (168) unit affordable rental housing community for families earning sixty percent (60%) or below of the Area Median Income (“AMI”), located at 5501 Penn Crossing Drive, District Heights, Maryland 20747.
candidates.wording: sixty percent (60%) or below of the Area Median Income

candidates.quote: The PILOT will require a mandatory annual payment of no less than approximately one hundred thirty two thousand, forty eight dollars or seven hundred eighty six dollars per unit ($132,048 or $786, per unit) for the first year.
candidates.value: $132,048 or $786 per unit for the first year

candidates.quote: Thereafter, the required payment for these affordable units will increase by two percent (2%) for each subsequent tax year.
candidates.value: increase by 2% each subsequent tax year

candidates.quote: The PILOT agreement will remain in effect for forty (40) years, including the extended affordability period.

When considering the financial effects of the PILOT, the County will be providing yearly operating support of approximately one hundred thousand, seven hundred fifty five dollars ($100,755) to this affordable family housing development.
candidates.wording: yearly operating support of approximately one hundred thousand, seven hundred fifty five dollars
